{{Short description|American chemist (1921–2018)}}
'''Carl David Gutsche''' (March 21, 1921 – August 28, 2018) was an American chemist.

Gutsche was raised in [[La Grange Park, Illinois]]. He studied at [[Oberlin College]] and later earned a doctorate in organic chemistry from the [[University of Wisconsin]]. Gutsche taught at [[Washington University in St. Louis]] from 1947 to 1989 earning the rank of [[professor emeritus]].<ref name=":0" /> From 1989 to 2002, he was appointed Robert A. Welch Professor of Chemistry at [[Texas Christian University]]. Upon retirement in 2002, Gutsche moved to [[Tucson, Arizona]] and became a visiting scholar at the [[University of Arizona]].<ref name=":0">{{cite news |title=C David Gutsche |url=https://sites.google.com/site/cdgutsche/ |accessdate=December 18, 2018 |publisher=Google Sites}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Carl David Gutsche |url=https://www.legacy.com/obituaries/seattletimes/obituary.aspx?n=carl-david-gutsche&pid=190416252 |accessdate=December 18, 2018 |work=Seattle Times |date=October 7, 2018}}</ref>
